patients.summary: Graduate student with lifelong atopy (seasonal allergic rhinitis, mild persistent asthma on as-needed albuterol, atopic dermatitis) who joins in 2023. A dermatology consult for a winter eczema flare in 2025 is followed by solid-food dysphagia, eosinophilic esophagitis on biopsy, an ED visit for vomiting, and swallowed budesonide from GI in 2026.

documents.author: front desk
documents.body: Caller is starting a grad program this fall and moved to the area last month. Wants an internist here instead of driving back to his old doctor. documents.title: New Patient Visit
documents.author: PCP
documents.body:
22 y/o man here to set up primary care. Just started a graduate program and is renting nearby. Prior care was with a family practice back home; release signed today.

HISTORY
Asthma since early grade school. Calls it mild but it is more than occasional: uses albuterol a few times most weeks, more in spring and with colds. No ED visits or oral steroids he can recall. Never on a daily inhaler that he remembers.
Allergic rhinitis, spring worst. Tree, grass and ragweed pollen plus dust mites. Cetirizine every day, sneezing and itchy eyes controlled.
Eczema since infancy. Mostly the elbow creases. Triamcinolone 0.1% cream when it flares, works.
No surgeries. No hospital stays.

MEDS: albuterol HFA 90 mcg 2 puffs prn; cetirizine 10 mg daily; triamcinolone 0.1% cream bid prn flares.
ALLERGIES: pollens (tree/grass/ragweed), dust mites - environmental. No drug reactions reported.
FAMILY: Mom has seasonal allergies and eczema. Dad has asthma. One sister with atopic dermatitis. Everyone allergic, he says.
SOCIAL: Graduate student. Has never smoked. No alcohol, no drugs. Lives with one roommate. Bikes to campus.

ROS: no current wheeze. No chest pain, palpitations, GI or urinary complaints. Mood good, PHQ-2 0.

EXAM
Vitals as charted. Well appearing.
HEENT: nasal turbinates mildly pale, no polyps. TMs clear. Oropharynx clear.
Neck: no nodes, thyroid normal.
Lungs: good air movement, no wheeze, no prolonged expiration.
CV: RRR, no murmur.
Abd: soft, nontender.
Skin: antecubital fossae dry, no active patches.

ASSESSMENT / PLAN
1. Mild persistent asthma - stable by his report. Albuterol refilled as he runs low. Asthma action plan handout reviewed.
2. Allergic rhinitis, seasonal + dust mite - continue cetirizine.
3. Atopic dermatitis - quiet. Continue triamcinolone for flares.
4. Prevention - HIV and hep C screening today. Tdap given (last booster date unknown). Records will show childhood shots.
RTC for a physical next year, earlier if needed.

documents.title: Screening results
documents.author: PCP
documents.body: Hi Wyatt, your HIV and hepatitis C screening tests were both negative. Nothing else needed there. Welcome to the practice.

documents.title: Vaccine visit
documents.author: RN
documents.body: Here for flu and covid. Afebrile, feels well. Screening questions negative, no egg or vaccine reactions. Flu 0.5 mL IM left deltoid, 2023-24 COVID mRNA 0.3 mL IM right deltoid. VIS given. Waited 15 min, no reaction, left for class.

documents.title: Inhaler refill
documents.author: patient
documents.body: Hi, the trees are starting and my inhaler is almost empty. Could you send a refill to the pharmacy on file? Thanks, Wyatt

documents.title: RE: Inhaler refill
documents.author: RN
documents.body: Albuterol sent with one refill. If you find yourself needing it more than a couple of times a week this spring, let us know and we can get you in.

documents.title: Annual Physical
documents.author: PCP
documents.body:
Annual exam. Second year of his program, teaching a section this fall.

Asthma: spring was the usual, albuterol a few times a week in April and May, quiet since. No night waking now. No urgent visits.
Rhinitis: cetirizine daily, fine.
Eczema: one small flare at the elbows last winter, triamcinolone cleared it.
No new symptoms. Sleeping ok. PHQ-9 2.
Meds unchanged. Allergies: pollens, dust mites.
Never smoker, no alcohol.

Exam: vitals as charted, weight steady. Nose mildly boggy. Lungs clear, no wheeze. Heart RRR without murmur. Abdomen soft. Skin: elbow creases dry, no active patches. No lymphadenopathy.

Plan
- Asthma mild persistent, symptoms seasonal; albuterol as needed, refills on file.
- Rhinitis and eczema stable, same regimen.
- One-time lipid panel today.
- Flu and covid at a nurse visit in October.
Next physical in a year.
